description: Weekly dependency updates, grouped to keep the PR list short: one PR for non-major gems, one for Ruby, one for CI. Majors get their own PR. Minor and patch updates merge on their own once CI passes, except Ruby. Importmap packages and daisyUI are vendored files, so they only show on the Dependency Dashboard: update them with bin/importmap update (or by downloading daisyUI again).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A known vulnerability is fixed now: no waiting period, no schedule.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: .ruby-version as Rails writes it (ruby-4.0.9), which Renovate's ruby-version manager can't read. Scalingo and the Gemfile install this version.
Importmap pins with a version comment (pin "leaflet" # @1.9.4)
daisyUI, vendored in app/assets/tailwind (version in application.css)

packageRules.description: Gems: one PR for all minor and patch updates
Ruby: .ruby-version, Gemfile.lock and CircleCI's cimg/ruby image move together. Scalingo installs the version in .ruby-version, so give its buildpack a week to support it.
CI: CircleCI orbs in one PR
Postgres image in CI: minor and patch only. Its major must follow the Scalingo add-on's version in production.
Vendored front-end files (importmap pins, daisyUI): no PR, as Renovate can't download the new files. They show on the Dependency Dashboard; update them by hand.
maplibre-gl-worker is a file of maplibre-gl, not a package: it moves with it
Minor and patch updates merge on their own once CircleCI passes, through a PR so each merge keeps its CI result. Merging deploys production: check Monday's deploys afterwards.
Ruby is never merged automatically: Scalingo's buildpack must support the new version.
